# Raise AI

Raise AI is an AI upskilling company in Kerala, India. We teach working professionals how to use AI in their own job, through online AI courses, AI classes, workshops and training.

## Pages

- Homepage: Overview of Raise AI, live workshops, masterclass courses, student results, and founder story. URL: https://raiseai.in/
- About Us: Meet the founder Hadhi Muhammed P., read the story behind Raise AI, our core beliefs, and how we teach. URL: https://raiseai.in/about/
- Student Results: Watch AI commercial ads, product videos, and UGC reels made by students without a camera, studio, or shoot. URL: https://raiseai.in/results/
- Students: Meet the people who finished a Raise AI course, what they do, and what they said after learning AI for their own work. URL: https://raiseai.in/students/
- Reviews: Real voice-note reviews from people who joined the live AI webinar. URL: https://raiseai.in/reviews/
- Blog: Simple, practical guides on AI video, AI tools, and using AI at work. URL: https://raiseai.in/blog/
- Guide: How to make an AI video ad for free (step by step) using ChatGPT, Google Flow, Luma Dream Machine, ElevenLabs, and CapCut. URL: https://raiseai.in/blog/how-to-make-an-ai-video-ad-for-free/
- Blog RSS feed: https://raiseai.in/blog/rss.xml

## Courses

- Live AI workshop: Flow AI Fundamentals: A 2-hour online live class for beginners teaching how to make AI videos with free browser tools on Google Meet. URL: https://raiseai.in/webinar/
- AI Ad Video Production Masterclass: A 14-day live AI bootcamp in 7 modules covering precision editing, scripting, character consistency, AI influencers, product B-roll, UGC ads, and 3D, cartoon and cinematic styles. URL: https://raiseai.in/#courses

## Founder

Hadhi Muhammed P. is the founder of Raise AI. He is an AI entrepreneur and mentor who teaches in simple words, with real work on screen.
